mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5% in the trigger period, or the rate does not cross the threshold within the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 3.5% and a surge in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 24,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signal accommodative monetary policy and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline in instances where both triggers are met, or the correlation between proxies is below 0.7 in the interaction period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index below 326 in a late-cycle expansion regime signals cooling inflationary pressures, prompting investors to anticipate prolonged low rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite CPIAUCSL falling below 326 in the late-cycle regime, or the regime condition is not met in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in supply (INDPRO > 101.8) and demand (HOUST > 1246) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline when both proxies exceed thresholds, or the correlation between proxies is below 0.7 in the interaction period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in the tightening cycle, or the rate does not cross the threshold within the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% in a post-shock recovery regime signals labor market strength, prompting investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in the post-shock regime, or the regime condition is not met in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the INDPRO index above 101.8 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to show positive cumulative trends over 60 days when INDPRO is above 101.8, or the correlation with returns is below 0.3 over the period.
